

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(edgeR)

tds_genes = c(
  "DIO1", "DIO2", "DUOX1", "DUOX2",
  "FOXE1", "GLIS3", "NKX2-1", "PAX8",
  "SLC26A4", "SLC5A5", "SLC5A8", "TG",
  "TPO", "TSHR", "THRA", "THRB"
)

tumor_samples = read.csv(
  "data/1tumor_samples_final_68.csv"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, group) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  mutate(tissue_type_simple = "Tumor")

rna = read.csv(
  "data/raw rna/thyroid_rna_counts_112.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)

rna = rna %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ensembl,
    dplyr::all_of(tumor_samples$sample_id)
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("ensembl") %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(rna) = "numeric"
```

```{r}
dge = edgeR::DGEList(
  counts = rna
)

dge = edgeR::calcNormFactors(
  dge,
  method = "TMM"
)

log_rna = edgeR::cpm(
  dge,
  log = TRUE,
  prior.count = 1
)
```

```{r}
gene_map = readRDS(
  "data/ensembl115_gene_map.rds"
)

log_rna_df = as.data.frame(
  log_rna,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "ensembl_gene_id_raw"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ensembl_gene_id = sub(
      "\\..*$",
      "",
      ensembl_gene_id_raw
    )
  )

tds_gene_map = gene_map %>%
  transmute(
    ensembl_gene_id = sub(
      "\\..*$",
      "",
      ensembl_gene_id
    ),
    hgnc_symbol = trimws(hgnc_symbol)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(hgnc_symbol),
    hgnc_symbol != "",
    hgnc_symbol %in% tds_genes
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    ensembl_gene_id,
    hgnc_symbol
  )

tds_expression_mapped = log_rna_df %>%
  inner_join(
    tds_gene_map,
    by = "ensembl_gene_id"
  )
```

```{r}
tds_expression_matrix = tds_expression_mapped %>%
  dplyr::select(
    hgnc_symbol,
    dplyr::all_of(tumor_samples$sample_id)
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("hgnc_symbol") %>%
  as.matrix()

tds_expression_matrix = tds_expression_matrix[
  tds_genes,
  tumor_samples$sample_id,
  drop = FALSE
]

storage.mode(tds_expression_matrix) = "numeric"
```

```{r}
tds_tumor_gene_medians = apply(
  tds_expression_matrix,
  1,
  median,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

tds_tumor_centered = sweep(
  tds_expression_matrix,
  1,
  tds_tumor_gene_medians,
  "-"
)

tds_tumor_scores = colMeans(
  tds_tumor_centered,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


tds_df = bind_rows(
  tibble(
    sample_id = names(tds_tumor_scores),
    TDS = as.numeric(tds_tumor_scores),
    tissue_type_simple = "Tumor"
  )
) %>%
  left_join(
    tumor_samples %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_id,
        group
      ),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        "WTC-unexposed",
        "WTC-exposed"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
tds_df = tibble(
  sample_id = names(tds_tumor_scores),
  TDS = as.numeric(tds_tumor_scores),
  tissue_type_simple = "Tumor"
) %>%
  left_join(
    tumor_samples %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_id,
        group
      ),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        "WTC-unexposed",
        "WTC-exposed"
      )
    )
  )

tds_df = tds_df %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        "WTC-exposed",
        "WTC-unexposed"
      )
    )
  )

tds_medians = tds_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    median_TDS = median(
      TDS,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_label = paste0(
      "Median: ",
      round(median_TDS, 2)
    )
  )

ggplot(
  tds_df,
  aes(
    x = group,
    y = TDS,
    fill = group
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.55,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = tds_medians,
    aes(
      x = group,
      y = median_TDS,
      label = median_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    nudge_x = 0.29,
    nudge_y = 0.02,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.1
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "WTC-unexposed" = "dodgerblue4",
      "WTC-exposed" = "firebrick3"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.05, 0.25)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Thyroid Differentiation Score by WTC Exposure",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Thyroid Differentiation Score (TDS)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 13,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```

```{r}
wilcox.test(
  TDS ~ group,
  data = tds_df,
  exact = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
tds_iqr = tds_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1 = quantile(TDS, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(TDS, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(TDS, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(TDS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tds_iqr
```
